data.title: Building Academic Words with Classical Roots

targets.hint: An optical instrument used to view stars and planets across space.
targets.definition: A tubular device that makes distant celestial objects appear larger.
targets.sentenceContext: Astronomers used the giant ___ to inspect a newly discovered comet.

targets.hint: A famous person signature made with their own hand.
targets.definition: A signature written by a person, typically someone well known.
targets.sentenceContext: The young fan politely asked the author for an ___ inside the novel.

targets.hint: The planetary zone where all organisms exist.
targets.definition: The regions of surface, atmosphere, and waters occupied by organisms.
targets.sentenceContext: Pollution in the oceans threatens delicate habitats across the entire ___.

targets.hint: Energy produced by high underground temperatures.
targets.definition: Produced by or relating to internal underground heat.
targets.sentenceContext: Iceland generates clean electricity by tapping into deep ___ reservoirs.
